# span end

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:spanEnd`](gmeow-spanEnd.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/spanEnd>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/ai`](../../slices/ai.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The ending character offset (unicode code points, zero-based, exclusive) of a span. Pairs with [`gmeow:spanStart`](gmeow-spanStart.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; `?` -> [`xsd:nonNegativeInteger`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#nonNegativeInteger)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:spanEnd`](gmeow-spanEnd.md) from `?` to [`xsd:nonNegativeInteger`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#nonNegativeInteger) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to pin the exclusive end offset of a span in unicode code points, completing the half-open range opened by [`gmeow:spanStart`](gmeow-spanStart.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid an end offset without a matching [`gmeow:spanStart`](gmeow-spanStart.md), and avoid prose locators (those are the citations slice's [`gmeow:selectorTextPosition`](gmeow-selectorTextPosition.md)).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:spanEnd`](gmeow-spanEnd.md) alongside [`gmeow:spanStart`](gmeow-spanStart.md) as a zero-based exclusive code-point offset on the same span subject.

### Examples

- ex:c1 [`gmeow:spanEnd`](gmeow-spanEnd.md) 512.
